title: Transforming Collections With AI-enabled, Omnichannel Engagement
summary: See how Concentrix helped modernize a legacy collections operation with AI-enabled outreach, omnichannel engagement, and cloud-native CCaaS to improve resolution, contact rates, productivity, and cost efficiency.
body_markdown:
A large collections operation was running on a legacy outbound dialing platform. The model depended heavily on high-volume voice outreach, with limited digital integration and limited visibility into the customer journey. While this approach had supported scale in the past, it no longer matched changing customer expectations or the business’s need for more precise, data-led engagement.


A legacy, outbound-heavy collections model was delivering diminishing returns as customers shifted to digital channels. The challenge was clear:


- Drive better collections performance through smarter engagement


- Lower operating costs


- Stronger customer experiences


As right-party contact rates declined and customer expectations shifted toward digital engagement, the business needed a smarter, more scalable way to improve collections performance, reduce costs, and maintain strong compliance and customer experience standards.
